source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps suffering connected to the evaluative claim without calling suffering itself good.
key_decisions.before: This is evidence of God’s righteous judgment, so that you may be considered worthy of God’s kingdom, for which you are also suffering.
key_decisions.after: This is evidence of God's righteous judgment, so that you may be considered worthy of God's kingdom, for which you also suffer.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: This is evidence of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be considered worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are also suffering,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the letter's retributive claim and repeated affliction wording.
key_decisions.before: For it is righteous with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
key_decisions.after: Indeed, it is just for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: since indeed it is just for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps relief, solidarity and the public heavenly revelation.
key_decisions.before: and to give relief to you who are afflicted, along with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his powerful angels
key_decisions.after: and to give relief to you who are afflicted, along with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his powerful angels
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and to grant relief to you who are afflicted, as well as to us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains fire, vengeance/justice and both described groups.
key_decisions.before: in flaming fire, bringing judgment on those who do not know God and those who do not obey the good news of our Lord Jesus.
key_decisions.after: in flaming fire, bringing justice on those who do not know God and who do not obey the good news of our Lord Jesus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: in flaming fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and on those who do not obey the good news of our Lord Jesus.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps punishment language and the debated away-from relation without softening duration.
key_decisions.before: They will pay the penalty of eternal destruction away from the Lord’s presence and from the glory of his might,
key_decisions.after: They will pay the penalty of eternal destruction away from the Lord's presence and from the glory of his might,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his power,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the day's two purposes and the community's response.
key_decisions.before: when he comes on that day to be glorified among his holy ones and marveled at among all who trusted—because our testimony to you was trusted.
key_decisions.after: when he comes on that day to be glorified among his saints and marveled at among all who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: when he comes on that day to be glorified in his holy ones and to be marveled at among all who have believed—because our testimony to you was believed.
